# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SLOPE_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price pulling back to VWAP while the EMA ribbon is steeply upward signals a high-probability long continuation. The ribbon slope filter ensures the trend is strong, and the volume surge confirms institutional participation, reducing false pullbacks in chop.

## Mechanism

Enter long when price touches VWAP (within 0.1% of VWAP) after a prior bar where EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 and the 5-bar average slope of EMA8 is positive (>0.02), with volume on the touch bar exceeding 1.5x the 20-bar average volume. Exit: stop at the most recent swing low (chart-stop), take profit 1 at 1.5R, runner trailed 10% below the highest high since entry (HWM trail). Regime hints: VIX < 20, after 10:00 EST, and price has been above VWAP for >20 minutes indicating an established intraday uptrend.
